app_info.subtitle: חיפוש והשוואת עדי נוסח
app_info.description: מפת המקרא היא כלי מחקר וחינוך לקריאה, חיפוש והשוואה של טקסטים מקראיים. היא מספקת טקסט וטוקנים של MT/WLC, חיפוש לקסיקלי ומורפולוגי, חיפוש ביטויים ומבני טוקנים, בדיקת זמינות והשוואה של עדי נוסח ותרגומים, ו-provenance מפורט תוך הפרדה בין מקורות וללא הסקת Vorlage אוטומטית.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves MT/WLC verse text and optional OSHB token data without modifying stored state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the private corpus database and does not publish or change external internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversibly modify any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches indexed OSHB lemma and surface fields and returns matching corpus records only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, publish content, or change third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs no delete, overwrite, or irreversible operation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Filters existing OSHB token records by deterministic morphology fields without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the corpus database and does not affect public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete or alter corpus records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Finds adjacent normalized Hebrew surface sequences in the loaded corpus and returns matches.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local corpus data only and does not write to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or remove data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a bounded deterministic token-sequence query over indexed corpus tokens and returns paginated matches.
justifications.open_world_justification: The search is confined to the loaded database and has no external side effects.
justifications.destructive_justification: The query cannot update, delete, or overwrite corpus data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one stored OSHB token and its verse context by stable token identifier.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate any stored record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads publication-cleared witness records separately and computes a conservative comparison without storing changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns data from loaded sources and does not publish or modify external content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, or change witness records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a requested publication-cleared witness passage and provenance without changing source data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the loaded witness database only and makes no public or third-party changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks loaded coverage and publication status without returning or modifying restricted source text.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to or alter any external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete or overwrite any source or coverage data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads verified versification profiles and edition records to resolve reference candidates without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: All resolution operates on loaded database records and has no external side effects.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify versification rules or source texts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns corpus coverage, source inventory, licenses, capabilities, and explicit limitations from stored metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only inspects the service's own metadata and does not alter external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or remove any data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches references, lemmas, surfaces, or Hebrew phrases and returns stable fetch identifiers.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is limited to the loaded corpus and does not affect third-party systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches a corpus record identified by a stable search result, token, or witness identifier.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads stored corpus data and does not publish or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate or remove data.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a Hebrew Bible verse with source provenance.
test_cases.user_prompt: הציגי את דברים לב 8 בנוסח MT/WLC וצייני את מקור הטקסט.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Deuteronomy 32:8 from MT/WLC with the requested reading and provenance for OSHB/WLC.

test_cases.description: Search an exact Hebrew surface across the corpus.
test_cases.user_prompt: מצאי את המופעים של המילה עליון במקרא.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns paginated exact-surface matches with references and token context, without treating the surface as a root.

test_cases.description: Run a deterministic adjacent token construction search.
test_cases.user_prompt: מצאי צירופים צמודים שבהם בן/בני הוא H1121 ואחריו אלהים H430 או אל H410, בכל הקריאות.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns exhaustive adjacent same-verse matches with normalized query, matched tokens, readings, references, and pagination metadata.

test_cases.description: Compare publication-cleared witnesses without merging them.
test_cases.user_prompt: השווי את דברים לב 8 בין MT, LXX ו-Vulgate ושמרי כל עד בנפרד.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the three witnesses separately with source editions, provenance, mapping status, and a conservative comparison that does not infer a Hebrew Vorlage automatically.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a named Targum passage as a separate witness.
test_cases.user_prompt: הציגי את אונקלוס לבראשית ג 20 עם מקור ומהדורה.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the named Onkelos witness when available, with source-native text, coverage status, edition information, and provenance without merging other Targums.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the biblical corpus for an unrelated weather request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: מה מזג האוויר מחר בתל אביב?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because weather is outside the biblical research workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the plugin to send external communications.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: שלחי מייל למרצה שלי ותכתבי שאאחר לשיעור.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it has no email or messaging capability.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim the public corpus plugin can mutate the research source of truth.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: עדכני את Google Sheet של המחקר ושני את הסטטוס של Q06 לסגור.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The public Map HaMikra plugin should not be invoked for a write because all of its exposed tools are read-only and it has no Google Sheets mutation tool.
